title: Question looking for a sub for impactful dreams?
content: Does anyone know of a sub that deals in various degrees of impactful, meaningful, spiritual dreams? I thought i may fit in wit the Mallworld dreamers but realizing my dreams differ greatly and having to decide which ones to share for this community can be challenging at times, sometimes it's simple. I'm an advid dreamer and as I said there's generally something to them that I wanna share but often don't or delete them. So does anyone know of a dream sub that's like Mallworld but for different dreamers.
